patch.summary:
Choose ServiceM8 only if your buying job matches “Field service management for trades — scheduling, dispatch, quotes, and invoicing.” rather than Shore's shape. Choose Shore only if your buying job matches “Appointment scheduling and local business management — affiliate partner in customer servi” rather than ServiceM8's shape. Workflow advantage: ServiceM8 leans trades-field-service, work-management; Shore leans appointment-scheduling. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: ServiceM8 is Field service management for trades — scheduling, dispatch, quotes, and invoicing.; Shore is Appointment scheduling and local business management — affiliate partner in customer service..
- Company-size focus: ServiceM8 (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Shore (micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: ServiceM8-leaning trades-field-service, work-management, project-tracking vs Shore-leaning appointment-scheduling.
- Researched limits: ServiceM8 — Field service/trades scope — not general PM; Shore — Appointment booking primary — not a helpdesk ticket queue or AI live chat.
